commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' The corner is swung in but Burnley can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+3' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Burnley.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Zian Flemming (Burnley) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the right post. Close!
88' Substitution. Nathan Patterson (Everton) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Tyler Dibling walks off.
88' Here is a change. Armando Broja is going off and Scott Parker gives the last tactical orders to Zian Flemming (Burnley).
88' It will be a substitution. Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye (Burnley) is ready to enter the pitch as Marcus Edwards walks off.
86' The referee blows his whistle, Burnley are awarded a corner kick.
86' It's a yellow card for Tyler Dibling (Everton).
85' Everton win a corner.
80' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) for his blatant foul.
79' The ball goes out for a corner. Burnley can continue in their attacking effort.
78' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Everton.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jacob Bruun Larsen leaves the pitch and Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) comes on.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Thierno Barry (Everton) comes onto the pitch so that Beto can be given a rest.
69' David Moyes has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Merlin Rohl (Everton) replacing Carlos Alcaraz.
67' Scott Parker is stunned as referee Craig Pawson shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
63' Everton force a corner. They send men into the box.
63' Beto (Everton) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Martin Dubravka.
61' What a poor attempt! Florentino (Burnley) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
61' Burnley quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
61' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
60' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) fires the ball towards the left side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
57' CHANCE! Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) picks up a perfect pass inside the box, makes himself some space for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar.
53' Scott Parker is forced to make a change. Josh Cullen is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Florentino (Burnley).
49' Dwight McNeil (Everton) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Craig Pawson has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Beto (Everton) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
42' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 6:4.
34' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
32' Poor challenge! Josh Cullen (Burnley) is penalised for tripping and Craig Pawson blows his whistle.

29' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Martin Dubravka pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
25' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Armando Broja (Burnley) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
21' Josh Laurent (Burnley) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
14' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Everton comes to nothing.
14' Tyler Dibling (Everton) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
10' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Beto (Everton). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar.
7' The ball is out of play. Burnley will have a chance to score from a corner.
3' Kyle Walker (Burnley) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Everton will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Craig Pawson.
